notes: No extra-weird number (sigma(n) > 3n, proper divisors without two disjoint sets each summing to n) below 10^12, and no odd one below 10^18. Reduction: good is closed under multiples, so a least extra-weird number is primitive 3-abundant; prim3.c enumerates all primitive 3-abundant n <= X (15 046 633 for X = 10^12 apart from multiples of the six good 3-perfect numbers; 1 186 265 odd ones for X = 10^18) and finds two disjoint divisor sets for each. Outside Lean: the enumeration and subset-sum searches (prim3.c, xw.c; cross-checked by brute force to 3*10^7).
